commands.review_summary:
The PR adds a macOS 26-gated `imsg chat-background set|clear` command, JSON-RPC `chats.setBackground`/`chats.removeBackground`, injected-helper selector probing/dispatch, docs, skill text, and regression tests.

Reproducibility: not applicable. as a bug reproduction: this PR adds a new chat-background feature that current main does not have. The submitted live run is useful proof evidence, but it shows the new behavior is not visually working yet.

target.title: feat: add chat background probes
target.body:
## Summary
- add macOS 26-gated `imsg chat-background set|clear`
- expose RPC `chats.setBackground` and `chats.removeBackground`
- current branch invokes the runtime-confirmed IMChat transcript background selector `setTranscriptBackgroundAndSendToChat:transferID:` with staged IM file transfers
- list `chat-background` in `imsg status` feature output and remove the release-owned changelog hunk

## Current Proof Status
Local bridge proof shows the private selector is present and accepts set/clear calls, but visual verification is **not yet passing**: Omar did not see the background appear in the target group chat after the set call. Treat this PR as still needing true visual proof before it is mergeable.

Proof artifacts are stored locally under:
`/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-09/167-chat-backgrounds/`

Target was the Lobster test group, redacted here as `any;+;[group-guid]`.

`./bin/imsg status --json` after relaunch:
```json
{"v2_ready":true,"bridge_version":2,"selectors":{"chatBackground":true},"rpc_methods":["chats.setBackground","chats.removeBackground"]}
```

`./bin/imsg chat-background set --chat 'any;+;[group-guid]' --file /System/Library/.../rock-win.png --json`:
```json
{"chatGuid":"any;+;[group-guid]","background_set":true,"selector":"setTranscriptBackgroundAndSendToChat:transferID:","transferGuid":"51E5781F-5AB1-402F-992E-92FD8EF4A871"}
```

`./bin/imsg chat-background clear --chat 'any;+;[group-guid]' --json`:
```json
{"selector":"setTranscriptBackgroundAndSendToChat:transferID:","chatGuid":"any;+;[group-guid]","background_cleared":true}
```

## Verification
- head: `4bc7cd6`
- `swift format lint --recursive Sources Tests TestsLinux` ✅
- `git diff --check` ✅
- `make build` ✅ (existing warnings only: SQLite module-cache rebuild note, deprecated `NSKeyedUnarchiver unarchiveObjectWithData:`)
- `make test` ❌ local toolchain blocked before tests execute: `Tests/IMsgCoreTests/BridgeHelperLocatorTests.swift:2:8: error: no such module 'Testing'`
- `make lint` ❌ `swift format` passes, then local `swiftlint` crashes loading `sourcekitdInProc.framework`

## Notes
- This remains macOS 26-gated and fail-closed.
- Runtime inspection found transcript-background APIs, but the first argument likely needs a real transcript background details/wallpaper object; passing `nil` plus a transfer ID appears to be accepted but not visually effective.
